mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_state_transition (tenant_id, business_type, business_id, document_no, from_state, to_state, event, from_version, operator_id, trace_id) VALUES (#{r.tenantId}, #{r.businessType}, #{r.businessId}, #{r.documentNo}, #{r.fromState}, #{r.toState}, #{r.event}, #{r.fromVersion}, #{r.operatorId}, #{r.traceId}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, business_type, business_id, from_version) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, business_type AS businessType, business_id AS businessId, document_no AS documentNo, from_state AS fromState, to_state AS toState, event AS event, from_version AS fromVersion, operator_id AS operatorId, trace_id AS traceId FROM erp_state_transition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND business_type = #{businessType} AND business_id = #{businessId} ORDER BY occurred_at, id
